purpose: Verified anonymous official-source bulk collection. Counts are source-derived address facts, not independent Android user-flow coverage.
safety: No private app imports, subscriber identifiers, account queries, login or CAPTCHA bypass. Only anonymous public forms/APIs and their published client protocol.
No hardcoded benchmark addresses or queue assignments. Geographic metadata and OpenStreetMap street names discover source IDs only; queues come exclusively from each official source.

House letters and fractions remain distinct. No numeric range expansion. Duplicate/unknown connections participate in queue consensus. Exclusion or partial entrance scope cannot produce a whole-house queue.
Complete dictionary means the currently offered source was traversed; it does not establish 100% of all geographic houses.
Positive facts and explicit observations expire after 24h; cached discovery metadata never renews a house fact timestamp.
Original response archives contain public source bodies plus URL/method/hash/time and submitted public form fields. Normalized archives are local proof artifacts, not a release.

ternopil.protocol: One complete public grouped JSON table; select exact sourced city/community, use chergGpv only, literal house lists and actual provider IDs.

independentSourceReread.method: Deterministically selected source-derived positives were re-read via official /api/pw-accounts/building-groups. This checks API compatibility, not benchmark coverage.

limitations: The official table can omit houses absent from its published rows. Unknown or conflicting connections remain unknown.

zhytomyr.protocol: Discover all 19 official rem_id department forms; identify every department offering the target city, submit only offered anonymous mainform2 hidden and all-button fields, parse strict 7-column queue/subqueue table, then consolidate across all target branches.
limitations: Prior normalized.zip contains historical pre-guard14183positive claims and must not be published in place of final13543. The final guard refuses640claims potentially affected by exclusions or entrance/connection scope.
Literal house observations do not expand ranges and do not claim all geographic houses.

protocol.anonymousResponseCodec: AES-GCM matches the current published official frontend, including public client key derivation; tampered payloads fail authentication.
protocol.otherProductsNotSubstituted: ACHR index1 is a separate outage product; its non-null values never substitute for missing GPV.

geographicInventory.method: current independent complete highway-name response, cached after ordinary GET succeeded; no queue inputs

currentGpvPdf.currentnessEvidence: Both official current frontend and PDF heading state the period; fetch time alone is not used.
